Mizo.reason: The paper develops a speech corpus and fine-tunes ASR models specifically for the Mizo language.

Meitei.reason: The paper mentions that a model mistook Mizo speech for Meitei-lon (Manipuri language) during error analysis.

Hebrew.reason: The paper mentions that a model generated outputs in Hebrew script as an error during analysis.

Hindi.reason: The paper mentions that some model errors seemed to approximate Hindi vocabulary.

Russian.reason: The paper mentions a Russian-based Whisper model used in a separate study on Kildin-Sami as motivation.

English.reason: The paper mentions English in the context of translating data into Mizo and analyzing code-mixed English words in the speech.
